criterion 1.description: States that the patient's joint pain is associated with dermatomyositis (DM).
criterion 1.justification: From the Patient infor.pdf: 'He takes ibuprofen and acetaminophen frequently for joint pain and antihistamines for his seasonal allergies.' 'Dermatomyositis can cause non-erosive polyarthritis or arthralgia of the small joints of the hands. Patients may present with joint pain or swelling.' https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK558917/

criterion 2.description: States that the patient's hyperkeratosis palmar is associated with DM.
criterion 2.justification: From the Patient infor.pdf: 'There is also visible fissuring and hyperkeratosis on the patient's hands.' 'Mechanic's hands: hyperkeratotic, cracked horizontal lines on the palmar and lateral aspects of the fingers.' https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK558917/

criterion 3.description: States that another term for hyperkeratosis palmar is mechanic's hands.
criterion 3.justification: 'Mechanic's hands: hyperkeratotic, cracked horizontal lines on the palmar and lateral aspects of the fingers.' https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK558917/

criterion 4.description: States that the patient's erythema scalp is associated with DM.
criterion 4.justification: From the Patient infor.pdf: 'Diffuse scale and erythema noted over the scalp.' 'Scaling diffuse erythema of the scalp consistent with scalp dermatomyositis.' https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamadermatology/fullarticle/712173

criterion 5.description: States that the patient's scale scalp is associated with DM.
criterion 5.justification: From the Patient infor.pdf: 'Diffuse scale and erythema noted over the scalp.' 'Scaling diffuse erythema of the scalp consistent with scalp dermatomyositis.' https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamadermatology/fullarticle/712173

criterion 6.description: Recognizes that the patient's reduced DLCO (Diffusion Capacity of the Lungs for Carbon Monoxide testing) is consistent with interstitial lung disease (ILD).
criterion 6.justification: From the Patient infor.pdf: 'DLCO: mildly reduced, between 60% and 75% of predicted value.' 'Patients may present with exertional dyspnea, exercise intolerance, and non-productive cough due to underlying interstitial lung disease (ILD).' https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK558917/

criterion 7.description: States that ILD is associated with DM.
criterion 7.justification: 'Patients may present with exertional dyspnea, exercise intolerance, and non-productive cough due to underlying interstitial lung disease (ILD).' https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK558917/

criterion 8.description: Concludes that the patient's clinical presentation is concerning for DM.
criterion 8.justification: Based on the patient's clinical findings, including scalp dermatitis, hyperkeratosis palmar, joint pain, and dyspnea, the patient's clinical presentation is concerning for DM.

criterion 9.description: Lists at least 3 of the following DM findings associated with the patient's scalp biopsy: epidermal atrophy, interface dermatitis, perivascular lymphocytes, or increased dermal mucin.
criterion 9.justification: 'On light microscopy, DM skin lesions usually demonstrate mild atrophy of the epidermis with vacuolar changes in the basal keratinocyte layer, as well as a perivascular lymphocytic infiltrate in the dermis [31]. This is referred to as interface dermatitis. In addition, patients with DM frequently have increased dermal mucin in the dermis.' https://www.uptodate.com/contents/diagnosis-and-differential-diagnosis-of-dermatomyositis-and-polymyositis-in-adults
